notes.title: [UPDATE] Chained Backrooms v1.0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.0.5 is now in-game![/h1][p][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/522c93ddd4ac47b6203128b765bb65d919891bf6.png[/img]
[p][h2]List of changes:[/h2][p][/p][h2][b]
[list]
[*] Updated game balance - now items in the shop (improvements, etc) cost much cheaper
[*] Increased the timer by 20% - now more time to collect items and explore the location
[*] Removed the location with the rotating beam
[*] Fixed (hopefully) the problem with bad loading of costume colour in players
[/list]

notes.title: [RELEASE] CHAINED BACKROOMS - available now at 15% off
notes.content:
[h1]Chained Backrooms — NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM WITH 15% OFF[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/3d26e39450c866930b234f69b9a99a3c9b98ca46.png[/img]

[h2]Huge thanks to everyone who joined the beta and played the demo — your support helped bring this game to release ❤️[/h2]

[h2][list]
[*] Co-op survival where you're chained to other players  
[*] Procedurally generated Backrooms levels  
[*] Find and sell valuable items  
[*] Merchants, upgrades, and a real race against time  
[/list][/h2]

[h2]Bring your friends and dive into the BACKROOMS![/h2]

notes.title: [Demo] Demo v1.3.1 released
notes.content:
[h1]Demo v1.3.1 is already in the game![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/2b1b9e3ba9ae94f1db2c3a3f8be1cf242ac1c23d.png[/img]

[h2]List of changes:[/h2]

[h2][b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] The server list has been redesigned, it now shows the game state and the current day
[*] Reduced VHS effect in the main menu by players' requests
[*] Added microphone indication in game
[*] Added animations to the interface when changing XP, Stamina and Flashlight Charge
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed level generation. On the first level now will not be able to appear a large room
[*] Added ability to scan monsters
[*] Fix for chain dragging, to which the player is not attached
[*] Now ‘Old Bag’ item does not eat items when moving them around the inventory
[*] Added sound to torch
[/list]

[b]Level Design[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly changed the starting location
[*] Added a secret room. You can find it in the Shop location
[/list]


[b]Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Now when you buy improvements they are automatically applied
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: [Steam Next Fest] Full Demo-version release
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

[h2]We have released a demo version of our game Chained Backrooms, so far the game has implemented many game mechanics:

[list]
[*] Physical Chain
[*] Multiplayer
[*] Infinite Gameplay
[*] Procedural Generation
[*] Voice Chat
[*] Character Upgrade System
[*] and more
[/list][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/3a7079947ddbbc99695dcfc9d465164eb50adf8c.png[/img]

[h2]We also want to let you know that we will be taking an active part in Next Fest, which will take place from 9 to 16 June[/h2]

[h3]This is a great opportunity given to us by Steam to introduce the game to a wider audience.

At this point, the game is almost out of beta and we are ready to release a demo of our game.

Many thanks to our [b]BETA-TESTERS[/b] who have been testing our game for a month and finding various bugs! Thanks to them we fixed a lot of bugs and now the game is much better!

Our [b]FREE demo[/b] will be released soon, stay tuned for its release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/85f1d3c8a724ed4aff2d74d497ca1241cc70f649.png[/img]

To keep up to date with all the news about the development of the game, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8bJqp3XJ54]Discord server![/url] There you will have the opportunity to chat with the developers and other players![/h3]
